# What DS we need

  - one reference of in-vivo Colon vs.  Stomach
  - one reference of in-vivo IM vs. healthy / non-IM
  - Organoids +WR colon vs.Stomach (van Wetering + Bartfeld / Kayisoglu)
  - ex-vivo  IM vs. non-IM 
  - ex-vivo IM vs. healthy stomach
  - Marker genes of scRNA IM + healthy gut (SI, LI, stomach)

Idea: Best way of measuring RNA phenotype change is to look at scRNA derived signatures

```{r}
#tmp = read_excel("../../../../Data/ExtData/Zhang_scRNA/All_markers_Epi_with_intestine_BBKNN.xlsx", sheet = 1)
load("../../Data/ExtData/Zhang_scRNA/All_markers_Epi_with_intestine_BBKNN.Rdata")
tmp = subset(cluster_markers, p_val_adj < 0.05 & avg_log2FC > 0.5)

sc_sets = split(tmp$gene, tmp$cluster)

```





# Number of DE genes from each signature in IM, IM ex vivo and intestine ex vivo data

For each scRNA signatures, loop through all comparisons from that data set. For each data set, assess overlap of up-regulation within genes from the signature. 

```{r, fig.width=8, fig.height=6}
all_ovlp = list()
sel_ds = names(all_ds)
fc_threshold = 0.5
adj_p_threshold = 0.1

all_ovlp <- list()

for (n in sel_ds) {
  tmp = all_ds[[n]]
  
  comps <- names(tmp$dge)
  
  for (cc in comps) {
    tmp2 <- tmp$dge[[cc]]
    if("logFC" %in% colnames(tmp2)) {
      #LIMMA
      if("SYMBOL" %in% colnames(tmp2)) {
        r_up = subset(tmp2, adj.P.Val < adj_p_threshold & logFC > fc_threshold & !(SYMBOL=="" | SYMBOL=="NA"))
        r_down = subset(tmp2, adj.P.Val < adj_p_threshold & logFC < -fc_threshold & !(SYMBOL=="" | SYMBOL=="NA"))
        gs_col = "SYMBOL"
      } else {
        colnames(tmp2) <- gsub("Gene Symbol", "SYMBOL", colnames(tmp2))
        r_up = subset(tmp2, adj.P.Val < adj_p_threshold & logFC > fc_threshold & !(SYMBOL=="" | SYMBOL=="NA"))
        r_down = subset(tmp2, adj.P.Val < adj_p_threshold & logFC < -fc_threshold & !(SYMBOL=="" | SYMBOL=="NA"))
        gs_col = "SYMBOL"
      }
    } else {
      #DESeq2
      r_up = subset(tmp2, padj < adj_p_threshold & log2FoldChange > fc_threshold & !(GeneSymbol=="" | GeneSymbol=="NA"))
      r_down = subset(tmp2, padj < adj_p_threshold & log2FoldChange < -fc_threshold & !(GeneSymbol=="" | GeneSymbol=="NA"))
      gs_col = "GeneSymbol"
    }
    
    for (gs in names(sc_sets)) {
      set_genes = sc_sets[[gs]]
      all_ovlp[[paste0(n,"___",cc,"___UP_",gs)]] = intersect(set_genes, r_up[[gs_col]])  
      all_ovlp[[paste0(n,"___",cc,"___DOWN_",gs)]] = intersect(set_genes, r_down[[gs_col]])
    
    }
  }
}
```


## Up-regulated genes in DS that overlap with signature genes

```{r}
up_res <- all_ovlp[grepl("_UP_", names(all_ovlp))]

tmp <- strsplit(names(up_res), "___")
res_desc <- data.frame(id = names(up_res), 
                       ds = sapply(tmp, `[`, 1), 
                       comp = sapply(tmp, `[`, 2),
                       celltype = sapply(tmp, `[`, 3) |> gsub("UP_", "", x=_)
                       )
res_desc$label <- paste0(res_desc$ds, "_", res_desc$comp)
res_desc$up_cnts <- up_res[res_desc$id] |> lapply(length) |> unlist()


res_desc$ds_type <- ds_to_type[res_desc$ds]

```

```{r, fig.width=8}
for (ct in unique(res_desc$celltype)) {
  tmp <- subset(res_desc, celltype == ct)
  
  up_cnts <- up_res[tmp$id] |> lapply(length) |> unlist()
  up_cnts <- sort(up_cnts)
  group <- tmp[match(names(up_cnts), tmp$id), "ds_type"] |> factor(levels=group_levels)
  names(up_cnts) <- tmp[match(names(up_cnts), tmp$id), "label"]
  
  cols = bar_cols[as.character(group)]
  par(mar=c(5,20,4,1))
  barplot(up_cnts, horiz=T, main=ct, las=2, cex.names = 0.8, col = cols)
  legend("bottomright", legend=levels(group), fill=bar_cols)
}
```

# Mean and median signature log2FC


```{r, fig.width=8, fig.height=6}
all_ovlp = list()
sel_ds = names(all_ds)
fc_threshold = 0.5
adj_p_threshold = 0.1

all_mean_lfc <- list()
all_median_lfc <- list()
all_huberM <- list()

for (n in sel_ds) {
  tmp = all_ds[[n]]
  
  comps <- names(tmp$dge)
  
  for (cc in comps) {
    tmp2 <- tmp$dge[[cc]]
    
    if("logFC" %in% colnames(tmp2)) {
      #DESeq2
      lfc_col <- "logFC"
      if("SYMBOL" %in% colnames(tmp2)) {
        gs_col = "SYMBOL"
      } else {
        gs_col = "Gene Symbol"
      }
    } else {
      #LIMMA
      lfc_col <- "log2FoldChange"
      gs_col = "GeneSymbol"
    }

    for (gs in names(sc_sets)) {
      set_genes = sc_sets[[gs]]
      set_gene_agg_lfc <- tmp2[match(set_genes, tmp2[[gs_col]]), lfc_col ]
      
      all_mean_lfc[[paste0(n,"___",cc,"___",gs)]] = mean(set_gene_agg_lfc, na.rm=T)
      all_median_lfc[[paste0(n,"___",cc,"___",gs)]] = median(set_gene_agg_lfc, na.rm=T)
      all_huberM[[paste0(n,"___",cc,"___",gs)]] = huberM(set_gene_agg_lfc)$mu
    }
  }
}
```

```{r}
lfc_res <- all_mean_lfc

tmp <- strsplit(names(lfc_res), "___")
res_desc <- data.frame(id = names(lfc_res), 
                       ds = sapply(tmp, `[`, 1), 
                       comp = sapply(tmp, `[`, 2),
                       celltype = sapply(tmp, `[`, 3) |> gsub("UP_", "", x=_)
                       )
res_desc$label <- paste0(res_desc$ds, "_", res_desc$comp)
res_desc$mean_lfc <- all_mean_lfc[res_desc$id] |> unlist()
res_desc$median_lfc <- all_median_lfc[res_desc$id] |> unlist()
res_desc$huberM_lfc <- all_huberM[res_desc$id] |> unlist()


res_desc$ds_type <- ds_to_type[res_desc$ds]

```



## Mean logFC


```{r, fig.width=8}
for (ct in unique(res_desc$celltype)) {
  tmp <- subset(res_desc, celltype == ct)
  tmp <- tmp[order(tmp$mean_lfc, decreasing = F),]
  
  group <- tmp$ds_type |> factor(levels=group_levels)
  cols = bar_cols[as.character(group)]
  par(mar=c(5,20,4,1))
  barplot(tmp$mean_lfc, names.arg = tmp$label, horiz=T, main=ct, las=2, cex.names = 0.8, col = cols, xlab = "Mean log2FC")
  legend("bottomright", legend=levels(group), fill=bar_cols)
}
```

# GSEA

```{r, fig.width=8, fig.height=6}
all_gsea = list()
sel_ds = names(all_ds)
fc_threshold = 0.5
adj_p_threshold = 0.1

bpparam = MulticoreParam(worker=8, manager.hostname="127.0.0.1")

for (n in sel_ds) {
  tmp = all_ds[[n]]
  
  comps <- names(tmp$dge)
  
  for (cc in comps) {
    tmp2 <- tmp$dge[[cc]]
    
    if("logFC" %in% colnames(tmp2)) {
      #DESeq2
      lfc_col <- "logFC"
      if("SYMBOL" %in% colnames(tmp2)) {
        gs_col = "SYMBOL"
      } else {
        gs_col = "Gene Symbol"
      }
    } else {
      #LIMMA
      lfc_col <- "log2FoldChange"
      gs_col = "GeneSymbol"
    }

    
    tmp3 <- tmp2[!is.na(tmp2[[gs_col]]) & !tmp2[[gs_col]] %in% c("","---") & !is.na(tmp2[[lfc_col]]),]
    
    tmp3[[lfc_col]] <- ifelse(is.infinite(tmp3[[lfc_col]]), sign(tmp3[[lfc_col]]) * 10, tmp3[[lfc_col]])
    
    ranks <- unlist(tapply(tmp3[[lfc_col]], as.character(tmp3[[gs_col]]), function(x) x[which(abs(x)==max(abs(x), na.rm=T))] ))
    
    fgseaRes <- fgsea(sc_sets, ranks, minSize=10, maxSize=2000, BPPARAM=bpparam)
    fgseaRes$ds <- n
    fgseaRes$comparison <- cc
    all_gsea[[paste0(n,"___",cc,"___",gs)]] <- fgseaRes
  }
}
```

```{r}
all_gsea_df <- do.call(rbind, all_gsea)
all_gsea_df$ds_type <- ds_to_type[all_gsea_df$ds]
all_gsea_df$label <- paste0(all_gsea_df$ds, "_", all_gsea_df$comparison)
```


```{r, fig.width=8}
for (ct in unique(all_gsea_df$pathway)) {
  tmp <- subset(all_gsea_df, pathway == ct)
  tmp <- tmp[order(tmp$NES, decreasing = F),]
  
  group <- tmp$ds_type |> factor(levels=group_levels)
  cols = bar_cols[as.character(group)]
  par(mar=c(5,20,4,1))
  barplot(tmp$NES, names.arg = tmp$label, horiz=T, main=ct, las=2, cex.names = 0.8, col = ifelse(tmp$padj < 0.05, cols, "grey80"), xlab = "NES")
  legend("bottomright", legend=levels(group), fill=bar_cols)
}
```
